Package httyd.data

Class Profile

java.lang.Object
httyd.data.Profile

      public int addCoins(int amount)
      Adds coins to the balance (used by the free demo top-up). The balance never goes above GameRules.MAX_COINS.
      Parameters:
      amount - the coins to add, greater than zero
      Returns:
      the coins that were really added (less than amount if the cap was reached)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if amount is not positive

    • canFuse

      public boolean canFuse(int targetId, int fodderId)
      Checks whether a duplicate can be fused into a dragon.
      Parameters:
      targetId - the dragon that gets the star
      fodderId - the duplicate that is consumed
      Returns:
      true if both exist, are different dragons of the same species and the target is below the maximum star level

    • fuse

      public void fuse(int targetId, int fodderId)
      Fuses a duplicate into another dragon of the same species: the duplicate disappears and the target gains one star.
      Parameters:
      targetId - the dragon that gets the star
      fodderId - the duplicate that is consumed
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the fusion is not allowed
